C0750.title: Rental Apps Digua, Zuxinxiang, and Zuzhangmen Flagged for Privacy Violations
keywords: National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center
C0750.summary: In June 2026, the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center reported 71 non-compliant apps, naming three rental platforms—Digua, Zuxinxiang, and Zuzhangmen—for four violations including failure to prominently display privacy policies and incomplete public disclosures, exposing data compliance issues in the rental industry.

references.title: National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center detected 71 mobile applications illegally collecting and using personal information
